featured_reviews.name: Nishant Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our journey toward parenthood was not an easy one and like many couples in Mumbai, we found ourselves surrounded by countless IVF and fertility centres almost one in every locality. However, what truly distinguishes Ankoor Fertility Clinic from the rest is that, unlike many clinics that often feel driven primarily by commercial motives, this institution is driven by passion, integrity and genuine care for patients.

Before visiting Ankoor, my wife and I had already consulted two other gynecologists. Our previous experiences felt largely procedural, where treatments seemed to follow a fixed medical playbook with little effort to understand us as individuals. Meeting Dr. Kedar Ganla was a completely different experience altogether.

What impressed us most was his extraordinary dedication and depth of involvement in understanding every aspect of our lives not just our medical reports. He carefully studied our medical history, lifestyle, dietary habits, stress levels, routines and even patterns that we ourselves had overlooked. His approach was deeply analytical yet profoundly humane.

In many other fertility centres, we felt IVF would have been immediately recommended as the default solution. However, Dr. Kedar Ganla was remarkably honest with us. He explained that even if IVF were attempted immediately, the chances of success would remain low unless we first addressed certain health and lifestyle concerns. More importantly, he reassured us that, in his professional opinion, we did not necessarily require IVF at all. He believed that with disciplined lifestyle changes, proper diet, exercise, weight management, and medication, natural conception was genuinely possible for us.

He gave us clear health goals and monitored our progress rigorously during every consultation. In fact, he often reminded us like a strict yet caring school headmaster about the importance of discipline and consistency. At times he even scolded us for not following instructions properly, but today we realise that his firmness came from sincere concern and commitment toward our success. Sometimes, especially in one’s mid and late thirties, that kind of accountability becomes necessary.

The day we discovered that we had conceived naturally was one of the happiest and most emotional moments of our lives. We immediately remembered Dr. Kedar’s words when he confidently told us, “You will be able to conceive naturally.” and indeed, we did.

That, however, was only the first milestone of our pregnancy journey. There were additional complications and concerns during the pregnancy, many of which we may not fully understand technically even today by us. But throughout the entire journey, we placed complete trust in Dr. Kedar Ganla and Dr. Manjusha Ganla. They, along with their entire team, stood firmly beside us not only until delivery, but even during the post-pregnancy phase with unwavering support and care.

This review is not written for promotion, nor is it generated artificially. It comes from genuine gratitude and heartfelt appreciation. We simply wish to recommend and endorse doctor who practise medicine not merely as a profession, but as a passion and a responsibility toward human life.

We will always remain thankful to Dr. Kedar Ganla, Dr. Manjusha Ganla and the entire team at Ankoor Fertility Clinic for helping us achieve one of the greatest blessings of our lives.

featured_reviews.name: tommy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi everyone,

I visited this clinic for a friend and acted as a moral support to her as she was considering to freeze her eggs. The service and the consultation was decent, all the assistant doctors who took down the history were also helpful and polite. The doctor himself was very truthful, honest and had a clear cut attitude. I liked his approach as he was authentic.

The only thing that didn’t work out for me
towards the end of our 3 hour consultation process was the meeting with Dr. Dharam Shah, it didn’t feel natural and authentic. He came across as a little pushy and was going too quick, not realising that we are new to all of this. He was hard selling the idea of eggs freezing to us instead of walking through the process patiently.  It didn’t seem genuine and frankly speaking a little fear induced marketing gimmick.

To end the review, I’d recommend consulting various different clinics and doctors before starting your journey with the right one and not just falling for the trap just because a doctor is well renowned/celebrity doctor. Overall, I would say  Dr. Jatin and his service is great, definitely do consider them atleast for a consultation and then take a wise decision. Good Luck!

featured_reviews.name: Shama khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
After struggling for 15 long years of marriage with various treatments and no success, my husband and I were on the verge of losing hope. At 38 years old, I finally turned to Dr. Jatin Shah at Mumbai Fertility Clinic & IVF Center in 2022, and it was the best decision we ever made. Through his expert guidance and the clinic's advanced fertility treatments, we welcomed our precious baby girl that same year—a true miracle that filled our lives with unimaginable joy.
Encouraged by that success, we returned in 2025, and once again, Dr. Shah's personalized approach and unwavering support led to the birth of our healthy baby boy. His deep knowledge, compassionate care, and ability to tailor treatments to our specific needs made all the difference, turning what seemed impossible into reality not once, but twice.
My husband and I extend our biggest thanks to Dr. Jatin Shah and his incredible team—the nurses, embryologists, and staff who were always there with kindness, clear explanations, and emotional support throughout both journeys. You didn't just treat us; you became part of our family story. We are eternally grateful and highly recommend this clinic to anyone facing infertility challenges. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for making our dreams come true!

Finally long awaited dream of becoming parents has come true after span of 12 years😊

Its a long tough & painful journey that I had gone through these years for not having own child. In year 2016 I come to know through laproscopy that one of the fallopion tubes is completed blocked. I took various treatments (Allopathy/Ayurvedic/IUI) to get conceived. Sadly all were unsuccessful. Finally in the year 2019 I had opted for IVF at Mumbai based fertility clinic, sadly it was also unsuccessful. Thereafter COVID arrived in the country & I took break. After 2 years again I had started taking ayurvedic treatment and same was not successful. Later my husband also suffered from Azoospermia due to tuberculosis. This incident completely broke my heart. After few months my husband’s colleague advised us to visit *Mumbai Fertility Clinic and IVF Centre (Dr Jatin Shah)* and as per advice took treatment of IVF (for myself) and micro tese (for my husband) at this clinic.

Now we are delighted & overjoyed to announce that we are blessed with beautiful twins (a baby boy & a baby girl) on 26.11.2025.

Special thanks to *Dr Jatin, Dr Dharam, Dr Aparna, Mala Madam & entire team*. You all are next to God🙏😇

I would advise specially those having infertility issues must visit this clinic. Miracle happens & I witnessed the same🙏😇
